add_toolbar_reaction.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): an emoji reaction on an internal comment thread.

buy_addon.rationale: Executes a purchase against the account's payment method.

buy_domain.rationale: Registers a domain, a billed and externally binding act.

buy_pro.rationale: Executes a plan upgrade with recurring cost.

change_toolbar_thread_resolve_status.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): marks a comment thread resolved or unresolved.

check_domain_availability_and_price.rationale: Pass-through (read): domain availability and pricing. Charges nothing.

deploy_to_vercel.rationale: Deploys arbitrary files to a new project and serves them publicly.

edit_toolbar_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): edits a team-internal comment on a preview deployment.

get_access_to_vercel_url.rationale: Credential disclosure. Mints a _vercel_share link that bypasses authentication on a protected deployment — a transferable capability the caller keeps, not a read of metadata.

get_agent_run_trace.rationale: Pass-through (read): agent run trace and messages.

get_domain_order.rationale: Pass-through (read): status of a domain purchase already made.

get_project_deployment_protection.rationale: Pass-through (read): reports protection settings. Reveals posture; the write path update_project_deployment_protection is governed.

get_purchase_quote.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): states in its own description that it NEVER charges. It mints the idempotency key the governed buy_* tools consume.

get_runtime_logs.rationale: Pass-through (read): application runtime logs, which may echo application data.

get_web_analytics.rationale: Pass-through (read): aggregate visitor and pageview counts.

import-claude-design-from-url.rationale: Imports a self-contained bundle from an external URL into Vercel. Content injection from a source the approver should see.

list_agent_run_projects.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): projects with agent observability data.

list_toolbar_threads.rationale: Pass-through (read): comment threads for a team.

reply_to_toolbar_thread.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): replies to a team-internal comment thread.

update_project_deployment_protection.rationale: Can remove password protection, Vercel Authentication, and Trusted IP restrictions, exposing previously private deployments.

web_fetch_vercel_url.rationale: Pass-through (read): fetches a Vercel deployment URL and returns the response. Scoped to deployments the token already reaches.
